avis.titre: I'm Not Sure This Is The Product For Me
avis.texte: I only recently began using Byoma De-Puff and Brightening Eye Gel. I like the creamy gel texture and it feels nice going on, but I'm really not sure it's doing anything. I'm sure it's hydrating but I don't notice a difference in puffiness or brightening, although I don't have dark circles to brighten. I do, however, have puffiness... In all fairness, I have under eye bags from lack of sleep and it's probably unrealistic to think it will help all that much anyway. I suspect this would be perfect for someone younger with little to no puffiness. If you're in your 20's or 30's and only looking for hydration, I think this would be a great product!

avis.titre: Beautiful Packaging, Great Price, but Needs Improvement
avis.texte: The price for this eye cream indicates its performance level. I know I purchased this eye cream for less than $25.00. Rule of thumb, you should never be depending solely on eye cream to get rid of the appearance of dark circles - the magic potion is sleep! But if you want an eye cream that will perform noticeable results, you should expect to spend anything over $50 to $75. I did not see any results from this eye cream - it just was a lubricant barrier. I work a stressful job primarily on computers and aim to get 7-8 hours of sleep per night, so those also play a factor. I did read the most positive helpful review. I have sensitive combo skin. I did not report feeling any sting from this product. On the other hand, the most negative critical review was very eye opening for me (no pun intended!) because I did not realize you could even break apart the product. I write my product reviews when I'm done with a product. I thought I had used all this eye cream a month ago. When I opened this eye cream, I still had ONE THIRD of the product left! The straw didn't even reach the bottom! I hope this isn't some sneaky marketing tactic by Byoma. Hats off to whoever made the bottle, but it's ineffective. Life hack, if you aren't getting anything out of the pump, bang the can on a hard surface and it will come out. It's also possible to fit a Q tip in there.

avis.titre: One product I will always repurchase
avis.texte: This eye gel has been a necessity in my skincare routine for about two years now. I have very dark circles thanks to genetics and I have fair olive skin so, as you can imagine, I have searched high and low for products to solve this issue and this one is easily the top choice for me. The price is very reasonable and the gel is easy to apply (and it feels nice on your skin!) I have found that for the best results this should be used at least once a day. I personally put it on at night because the gel leaves a residue until it fully absorbs into the skin and when I wake up I can noticeably see a big difference! I will say that consistency is key with this product and if you don't use it at least once a day the dark circles will return. I do not struggle a lot with puffiness under my eyes so I unfortunately cannot give an exact review on that, however, I have used this the morning after a night out on a few occasions where there was some puffiness and I noticeably saw it go down within a few hours of applying the product. Overall, I highly recommend for anyone to try it out!
